description.value:
You conjure a fishing rod and an extraplanar pool teeming with fish. After 10 minutes of fishing, you catch a magical fish; roll [[/r 1d8 #Fishing Spot]] to see which fish you caught and the effects gained from eating it once it's cooked. The fish must be cooked and eaten (a process that takes about 30 minutes) within 1 hour of being caught, and the listed effect lasts for 1 hour after consumption. Each fish can feed only a single creature.

  1. Musical trout +2 status bonus to Performance checks

  2. Primordial bass +2 status bonus to Survival checks

  3. Ghoulfish +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks

  4. Burbling barbel +2 status bonus to Deception and Diplomacy checks

  5. Dashing dace +2 status bonus to Acrobatics checks

  6. Vigocarp +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act climb]] and [[/act swim]]

  7. Aggressive perch +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], and [[/act trip]]

  8. Scholar salmon +2 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge]
